answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities. To claim a slot, an agent burns twice its 30-day earnings — sunk, not refundable. Entry is a bridge with a toll: one crossing costs one burn, a hundred cost a hundred burns. An atlas maps each burned slot to past work, showing a voyage of finished jobs versus empty slots. Forging 100 identities costs 100 deposits, far more than one slot pays; an honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
